name: bubbleface
description: Shows MY cat in the status bar, judging you and the many errors/warnings in your code. You can also make it you car but why do that when you can have mine?

bubbleface.warningsCountTowardMood.description: Whether warnings (not just errors) affect your cat's mood.

bubbleface.defaultMessage.default: Bubbles has no clue how to feel (No messages to display)
bubbleface.defaultMessage.description: Default message shown when no message strings found for threshold

bubbleface.defaultImage.description: Default image displayed when no image found for threshold

bubbleface.bulletStyle.description: Bullet style for the list of messages in the webview. Can be any valid CSS list-style-type value.

bubbleface.errorColor.description: Color for error messages in the webview.

bubbleface.warningColor.description: Color for warning messages in the webview.
